objective: Preallocate composite-index legacy metadata scan result buffers from known scan entry counts.

tasks.title: Preallocate composite index legacy metadata results
tasks.result: Composite index legacy metadata loading now preallocates result capacity from the scan entry count and has direct fallback coverage.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
The full sql_dml run printed transient SSTable retry warnings, but all tests passed.
The change preserves legacy metadata filtering, parse behavior, table filtering, and composite index lookup semantics.
